main_body: raised wooden farm hut with tiled roof
top_band: tiled roof slope with ridge cap and yellow-cream ridge highlights through red/orange/purple roof tiles (rows 0-21)
evidence: Rows 0-21 show the pitched tiled roof slope seen from above; row 21 forms the front eave edge overhanging a 2-row dark eave shadow (rows 22-23) above the wooden wall (rows 24-34) with recessed doorway and window, plus a raised deck and stilts (rows 35-43).

style.evidence: The roof tiles use the exact Beodeul 6-step ramp (cream highlight, orange, terracotta, maroon, deep purple, dark brown edge) with scalloped tile texture, and the wooden walls have detailed plank/log grain matching the reference annex.
